findings.finding: The wrapper test still proves managed_pid accepts a redis-server wrapper that execs a live copy named redis-server.bin: the wrapper is restored to exec actual_server "$@", status is still asserted against scripts/palimnex_redis.sh, and the identity check in managed_pid is unchanged. The new SkipTest when neither /bin/sleep nor /bin/sh runs under the copied name is weaker than the original hard failure on /bin/sleep.

_copy_long_running_binary treats probe exit 0 as proof the copy keeps its name. That rejects multicall coreutils sleep and prefers /bin/sleep on macOS, which matches the intended runners. The sh probe would also return 0 on a re-execing /bin/sh if sleep were unusable; managed_pid would then fail rather than skip. Path("/bin/sleep").read_bytes() is uncaught, so a missing first candidate errors instead of falling through to /bin/sh. The sh fallback loop can leave an orphan sleep grandchild for up to one second after SIGTERM of the copied shell.

checkout_id is still checked: the test asserts it equals sha256(utf-8 of STABLE_GOLDEN_ROOT.resolve()), which is the formula in palimnex/retrieval.py _retrieval_result, then hashes a copy whose checkout_id is replaced by sha256(utf-8 of the unresolved path). GOLDEN_DIGESTS still pin every other output field; the live checkout_id bytes are no longer inside those digests.

The influence golden uses the same split: assertTrue(all(...)) that every retrieval and context checkout_id equals the resolve() digest, then RETRIEVAL_GOLDEN_SHA256 and CONTEXT_GOLDEN_SHA256 hash portable substitutions. That bulk assertTrue is a weaker diagnostic than the shadow test's assertEqual; a missing checkout_id still KeyErrors. assemble_context copies sources["checkout_id"], so the context check still covers propagation. Golden hash constants are unchanged.

Commits 5edc164 and ce4fde2 touch only palimnex/tests/test_redis_launcher.py, palimnex/tests/test_retrieval_influence.py, and palimnex/tests/test_retrieval_shadow.py. They do not modify scripts/palimnex_redis.sh, palimnex/redis_launcher.sh, any source_id bound by ontology/concept-registry.v1.json, or the influence_implementation_digest modules palimnex/concepts.py, palimnex/ontology_influence.py, palimnex/ontology_shadow.py, and palimnex/retrieval.py.

limitations: Read-only review; Palimnex, Redis, the network, and the test suite were not run.
Portability of copied /bin/sleep then /bin/sh is reasoned from managed_pid in scripts/palimnex_redis.sh and the commit messages, not executed on Ubuntu or macOS runners.
